pl_coverage_gaps.gap: No open Premier League 360 data: StatsBomb has 0 PL matches with 360 frames, only shot freeze frames
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: PL lessons cannot show where every player stood at each event
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Use shot freeze frames for PL examples; teach 360 ideas on labelled non-PL StatsBomb 360 matches

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: PL tracking and off-ball movement only from Last Row: 13 Liverpool goals, informal licence, self-described as too inaccurate for research
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: No continuous PL off-ball footage for Watch Gym, pitch control or pressing lessons
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: PL off-ball reconstructions use labelled non-PL tracking (DFL Bundesliga); Last Row stays local with credit

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: No open provider in the coverage matrix offers Premier League physical data
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: Sports-science lessons cannot use PL distance, sprint or load numbers from open data
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Use published study figures with citation and labelled non-PL tracking; never invent PL physical numbers

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: StatsBomb terms bar giving the data to third parties and commercial use of derived analysis
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: StatsBomb-derived PL clips and tables cannot ship in the Vercel bundle
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: StatsBomb artifacts stay in the local study build on the deploy deny-manifest; the deployed PL supply is Wyscout 2017/18 events (CC BY)

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: The reusable data-credit element with a logo slot does not exist yet
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: No lesson may show StatsBomb-derived visuals until the credit and logo render
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Phase 4/5 builds the credit element; Phase 3 manifests carry the credit text

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: FBref advanced (Opta) statistics were removed on 2026-01-20
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: No live free source of PL xG and advanced player stats on FBref
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Compute metrics from open event data in the pipeline; FBref is recorded as removed and never cited as live

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: transfermarkt-datasets updates are paused and the data stops in July 2026; the CC0 licence does not clear the Transfermarkt terms
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: No current open market-value or transfer data for Track 23
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Keep transfermarkt-datasets local only; type valuations by hand with a link and an as-of date

pl_coverage_gaps.gap: Understat shows only a returning-soon notice and Capology terms returned 403, so neither has known terms
pl_coverage_gaps.impact: No open xG fallback from Understat and no licensed wage data
pl_coverage_gaps.mitigation: Read by hand, never scrape; wage figures typed by hand with a link; re-check both at the start of Tracks 16 and 23
